universal-healthcare.rationale: Rejects public coverage beyond Medicare and Medicaid.

markets-allocate-better.rationale: Strongly agreed that free enterprise is an essential element of a productive economy and says liberal policies don't work while conservative ones do.

tax-the-wealthy.rationale: Rejects higher taxes on wealthier taxpayers.

unions-good.rationale: Defends normal player solidarity for full pay, while urging exceptional pandemic compromise.

property-fundamental.rationale: Strongly agreed that the right to private property is an essential element of a productive economic system; he did not speak to overriding it.

regulate-corporations.rationale: Praises Texas for allowing businesses to grow without excessive government burdens.

limit-guns.rationale: Explicitly rejects restrictions on gun ownership.

empower-police-military.rationale: Campaigns to back police and strengthen Joint Base San Antonio.

decide-locally.rationale: He pledges to abolish the Department of Education and return control to states and communities, but wants federal action against states' ballot practices he dislikes.

traditional-family.rationale: Treats heterosexual marriage as divinely ordained.

same-sex-marriage.rationale: Insists legal marriage is exclusively heterosexual.

abortion-legal.rationale: Permits abortion only for maternal life.

more-religion-public.rationale: Presents public service and political renewal as requiring Christian faith.

open-borders.rationale: Demands a secure border and deportation of unauthorized immigrants.

expand-nuclear.rationale: Includes nuclear expansion in energy-dominance agenda.

political-violence-never.rationale: His support for military strikes accepts some political use of armed force.

separate-church-state.rationale: Affirms nonestablishment but insists Christian values guide officeholding.

school-vouchers.rationale: Actively advocates publicly funded parental school choice against the government-school monopoly.

reason-over-faith.rationale: Says faith is the most important thing in his life and that he will always be guided by it, which contradicts reason as the only guide.

expand-fossil-fuels.rationale: Would unleash Texas oil and gas production.

political-elite-corrupt.rationale: Presents himself as an outsider who wants to help clean up Washington and attacks career politicians and the Deep State on his issue page.

religious-exemptions.rationale: Defends religiously motivated refusals of service.

patriotic-education.rationale: Demands patriotic American and Texas education.

end-racial-preferences.rationale: His anti-DEI pledge opposes institutional preference programs; detailed admissions and hiring rules are unspecified.

freedom-to-discriminate.rationale: Supports business refusals on religious grounds.

non-intervention.rationale: Supports US strikes on Iran’s nuclear facilities, qualifying earlier restraint rhetoric.

gender-identity-recognition.rationale: Rejects gender-identity access to sex-segregated spaces.

term-limits.rationale: Explicitly campaigns for congressional term limits.

foreign-residents-local-vote.rationale: His citizen-only election pledge excludes noncitizen voting without distinguishing local contests.

politics-spiritual-struggle.rationale: Interprets political assassination and polarization through evil and redemption in Christ.

defensive-wars-only.rationale: Endorses striking Iranian nuclear facilities to prevent a perceived future weapons threat.

state-arms-monopoly.rationale: Defends civilian ownership without gun restrictions.

notes:
His earlier environmental work emphasized restoring urban waterways, parks, transit access and affordable housing. That advocacy and recognition of climate concerns do not establish support for drastic government climate measures. His January-primary questionnaire is candidate-supplied evidence, distinct from the website’s ideological rating. Recent support for Iran strikes qualifies restraint rhetoric; ending every alliance or all intervention is not established. Immigration enforcement does not establish a preferred numerical limit on lawful immigration. His service-refusal position concerns religious objections, not every discriminatory ground. The spiritual-struggle answer uses his interview segment, not Clay Travis’s or the host’s comments. Spending cuts and entitlement reform do not establish a welfare-dependency doctrine or legally binding fiscal rules. No policy is borrowed from Trump, Roy, advisers, endorsers or his opponent.

Merged with an independent claude-sonnet-5-5 audit: 4 answers taken from it, 16 agreed, 1 conflicts settled by the integrator.

claude-sonnet-5-5 notes: Independent second pass on a first-time candidate who has no voting record, so the evidence is campaign material and interviews. Searched all ten themes; positions exist only on economy, liberty, society, world, ecology and a little government. Searched and found nothing stated on: trade and tariffs, minimum wage, unions, climate policy now (a 2016 interview shows concern for urban greenspace and says athletes were slow to engage on climate change, but no current stance), UN and alliances, Israel's statehood, capital punishment, drugs, surveillance, constitutional structure, presidential term limits (he pledges only congressional term limits, so the unlimited-reelection statement is null). Political-violence-never is null: he calls the Kirk assassination and terrorism pure evil but does not address whether violence is ever justified. The Iran war is a state's use of force and not political violence. A Hannity interview with two athlete-candidates (YouTube UbW3bIPyoWs) has no speaker labels and was not used. A Newsmax full interview and a Ruthless podcast episode were unavailable. Texas Scorecard returned 403 and was read through the Wayback Machine.
